```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ent "<!ENTITY internal 'Expanded Entity Value'>">
  %ent;
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY ext SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns/root" xmlns:sub="http://example.com/ns/sub">
  <!-- Top-level comment exercising parser comment state machine -->
  <sub:child id="c1">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section containing markup <tags> and &internal; reference.
    ]]>
  </sub:child>
  <child>&internal;</child>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE doc [
  <!ELEMENT doc (section+)>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % paramDTD "<!ENTITY parsedEnt 'Nested Param &subEnt;'>">
  <!ENTITY subEnt "SubEntityData">
  %paramDTD;
]>
<?xml-processing-instruction target="afl" data="test-mode=true"?>
<doc xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml" xmlns:custom="http://example.org/custom">
  <!-- Comment before complex CDATA and entities -->
  <section id="s1">
    <?custom-pi data="value"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Another CDATA block with <script>alert(1)</script> and &parsedEnt;
    ]]>
  </section>
</doc>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY entA "ValueA">
  <!ENTITY entB "&entA; ValueB">
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY docPDF "manual.pdf" NDATA pdf>
  <!ENTITY % pe "<!ELEMENT meta (#PCDATA)>">
  %pe;
]>
<?xml-model href="schema.rng" type="application/xml-relax-ng"?>
<catalog xmlns="urn:isbn:1-931666-22-9" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Comment verifying namespace and entity resolution order -->
  <meta>Metadata element defined via parameter entity</meta>
  <item xlink:type="simple">
    <![CDATA[
      <item-details>&entB;</item-details>
    ]]>
  </item>
</catalog>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE testsuite [
  <!ELEMENT testsuite (testcase*)>
  <!ELEMENT testcase (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % extEnt SYSTEM "http://localhost/external.dtd">
  %extEnt;
  <!ENTITY safeEnt "Fallback Safe Entity">
]>
<?xml-stylesheet href="report.css" type="text/css"?>
<testsuite xmlns="http://junit.org/schema/testsuite" xmlns:xi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XInclude">
  <!-- Comment before recursive/fallback entity test -->
  <testcase name="tc1">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block testing edge cases with &safeEnt; and unparsed data.
    ]]>
  </testcase>
  <testcase name="tc2">&safeEnt;</testcase>
</testsuite>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE database [
  <!ELEMENT database (record*)>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY alpha "Alpha">
  <!ENTITY beta "α γ">
  <!ENTITY gamma "Gamma">
  <!NOTATION txt SYSTEM "text/plain">
  <!ENTITY readme "readme.txt" NDATA txt>
]>
<?database-control action="initialize" mode="strict"?>
<database xmlns="http://example.org/db" xmlns:db="http://example.org/db/ext">
  <!-- Comprehensive comment block with special chars < > & " ' -->
  <db:record id="rec-001">
    <?db-query sql="SELECT * FROM records"?>
    <![CDATA[
      <record-payload>
        Data containing entities like β inside CDATA.
      </record-payload>
    ]]>
  </db:record>
</database>
```
